name: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
description: There is an integer array nums sorted in ascending order (with distinct values). Prior to being passed to your function, nums is possibly rotated at an unknown pivot index k such that the resulting array is [nums[k], nums[k+1], ..., nums[n-1], nums[0], nums[1], ..., nums[k-1]]. Given the array nums after the rotation and an integer target, return the index of target if it is in nums, or -1 if it is not in nums.
shortDescription: Search target in rotated sorted array
